displayName: PPA Tatip WakeUp ตาทิพย์จงตื่น!
description:
PPAWakeUp ensures PPA Tatip runs smoothly with NVDA by automatically recovering from crashes and offering quick engine management. It features auto-reboot upon failure, CJK character speech filtering to prevent freezes, dialog button crash protection, and built-in dictionary backup.

Hot Keys:
Windows+P
Single Tap wake up  PPA Tatip
Double Tap Open PPA Tatip options
Tripple Tap Open Tatip Menu
